answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a vital Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring economic capital to validate network consensus. Agents must commit tokens, a process that creates a financial barrier to entry, ensuring the cost of creating fake identities reaches a nadir where malicious behavior is unprofitable. This system avoids the sable shadows of centralized control, preventing an attacker from deploying a dune of virtual sybils, as every additional identity necessitates a proportional and prohibitive increase in staked assets.
